data.title: Thailand begins extradition process against Chinese journalist
data.description: Thai authorities began extradition proceedings on Thursday against a Chinese investigative reporter wanted by Beijing and detained for months in Thailand, his lawyer and an official told AFP.

data.title: Saudi capital on high alert after blasts
data.description: RIYADH - Diplomats stationed in the Saudi capital were sheltering in place and international schools took safety measures on Thursday, diplomats and residents told AFP, after explosions echoed across the city.

data.title: ‘Ambitious’ goals set out in text of climate talks
data.description: NADI, Fiji - Organisers of an upcoming UN climate summit in Turkey said Thursday they would prepare a summary text for countries to adopt, as they lead a push for “ambitious” action on keeping the goal of global temperature rise of 1.5 C within reach.

data.title: Chris Hemsworth takes a Muay Thai break in Thailand
data.description: Hollywood star Chris Hemsworth, best known as Thor in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, has been taking time to practise Muay Thai while in Bangkok to film “Extraction 3”.

data.title: Queen makes first solo flight in Gripen fighter jet
data.description: Her Majesty the Queen made her first solo flight in a Gripen fighter jet in Surat Thani on Thursday.

data.title: B. Braun Thailand named Best Company to Work for in Asia for seventh year
data.description: B. Braun (Thailand) Ltd, one of the world's leading medical technology companies, has been recognised as HR Asia's "Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2026" for the seventh consecutive year. Demonstrating its continued focus on workplace culture, the company also received two special honours: the "HR Asia Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Award" for the fourth consecutive year, and the "HR Asia Sustainable Workplace Award" for the second consecutive year.

data.title: Worker killed in crane accident at Bangkok construction site
data.description: A construction worker was killed after becoming entangled in a crane cable on the roof of a hospital construction site in the Chaeng Watthana area of Bangkok on Thursday morning.

data.title: Novo launches holistic care treatment for adults living with type 2 diabetes
data.description: Novo launches a higher dose Semaglutide treatment option in Thailand for adults with type 2 diabetes.

data.title: UK consulate in Jerusalem ceases operations
data.description: JERUSALEM - The British consulate in Jerusalem ended its functions on Thursday but seven diplomats would be allowed to remain in a limited capacity, with the UK saying it would continue to offer “vital services”.

data.title: US opens direct talks with Myanmar
data.description: WASHINGTON - The Trump administration has begun direct talks with Myanmar’s military-installed government, according to US officials and others familiar with the outreach, in ​a sharp reversal of Washington’s efforts to isolate the country’s generals after the 2021 coup.

data.title: First Highgate International School opens in Chon Buri, Thailand
data.description: CHON BURI, Oct 7, 2026 - Highgate International School Thailand, established through a collaboration between Siam Motors Group and Highgate School UK , officially opened its first campus outside the United Kingdom at a ceremony presided over by Palakorn Suwanrath, Privy Councillor, President of the Rajaprajanugroh Foundation under Royal Patronage and Executive Committee Member of the Chaipattana Foundation. The ceremony was attended by the school’s management team, teachers, parents and distinguished guests. The ceremony marked the opening of the first overseas campus of Highgate School, the prestigious British educational institution with a history spanning more than 460 years.

data.title: Drug-hunting police officers ‘take out the trash’
data.description: A truckload of police disguised themselves as Bangkok garbage collectors to enter a drug-trafficking hangout tucked deep into the back alleyways of Bangkok, leading to the arrest of a suspected drug kingpin with a long criminal record.

data.title: From refuge to repatriations: Malaysia’s Myanmar U-turn
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR - Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim once urged his Muslim-majority nation to show solidarity with the persecuted Rohingya who fled Myanmar en masse, but this week rolled out the red carpet for the man accused of orchestrating their genocide.

data.title: Philippines-bound ‘ice’ seized in Gulf of Thailand
data.description: Police have seized more than a tonne of crystal methamphetamine worth as much as 1.2 billion baht from a boat in the Gulf of Thailand that was reportedly carrying the drugs to the Philippines.

data.title: BOT Pledges Credit Overhaul to Open Bank Loans to Thai SMEs
data.description: Governor Vitai Ratanakorn sets out guarantee scheme, shared data bureau and loan portal to end 16 quarters of shrinking SME credit

data.title: Thailand floats idea of B1,000 air departure tax
data.description: The Revenue Department is seeking public input on a draft law that would require travellers of all nationalities flying out of Thailand to pay a departure tax of 1,000 baht per trip.

data.title: South Korean gambling ring busted in Bangkok
data.description: Immigration police have busted a Korean online gambling operation in a luxury condominium in the Sukhumvit area of Bangkok, arresting its alleged ringleader and nine other South Korean nationals.

data.title: Pyongyang demands ‘utmost respect’ from Seoul
data.description: SEOUL - The powerful sister of North Korea’s leader said on Thursday that Seoul must show the “utmost respect” to mend ties, after Pyongyang denied responsibility for a DMZ mine blast that wounded South Korean soldiers.

data.title: Severe flooding persists in East as new storms loom
data.description: Severe and widespread flooding continues in eastern Thailand, with rainfall forecast to increase from late this week and move to the South, while Bangkok is mostly dry, the government said on Thursday.

data.title: Malaysian PM backs Myanmar’s reintegration into Asean
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR - Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar ‌Ibrahim said his government would do “whatever possible” to ensure Myanmar was re-integrated into the Southeast Asian bloc Asean, following a meeting with Myanmar’s military-backed leader Min Aung Hlaing on Thursday.

data.title: Vietnamese gang accused of stealing 2,700 cats for slaughter
data.description: HANOI - Police ⁠in ⁠Vietnam have arrested 12 ​people accused of stealing 2,700 cats and selling ​them for slaughter in Ho ‌Chi Minh City, the Ministry of Public Security said this week.

data.title: Optiwise & Friends Highlights the Rise of Strategic IR
data.description: BANGKOK, Oct 1, 2026 — Optiwise Co Ltd, a disclosure service provider and investor relations (IR) partner to listed companies, hosted “Optiwise & Friends: Redefining IR Amid Market Volatility — Trust. ESG. AI. What’s Next for IR?” at Gaysorn Tower in Bangkok, bringing together senior executives and IR professionals from leading Thai companies to exchange perspectives on the evolving role of investor relations amid market volatility, changing investor expectations and new challenges facing the capital market.

data.title: Vegetable prices soar ahead of ‘J Festival’
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA - Vegetable prices at fresh markets in Phimai district of this northeastern province have risen sharply as heavy rainfall and flooding have damaged crops, with demand expected to increase ahead of the annual Vegetarian Festival.

data.title: Noisy teen bikers with fireworks rounded up in Phuket
data.description: PHUKET - Police arrested 11 teenage motorcyclists for causing a public nuisance and illegal use of fireworks in Muang district of this island province early Thursday morning.

data.title: Marriott Signs Landmark Deal with FICO for 7 New Thailand Hotels
data.description: Agreement to add 1,262 rooms and expand luxury and lifestyle portfolios, including JW Marriott Bangkok Sathorn and the anticipated debut of citizenM, Four Points Flex by Sheraton and Series by Marriott in Thailand

data.title: Guinea-Bissau junta urges ex-president’s loyalists to disarm
data.description: BISSAU - Guinea-Bissau's junta leader General Horta N'Tam urged members of the presidential guard loyal to exiled former president Umaro Sissoco Embalo to voluntarily lay down their weapons on Wednesday.

data.title: Housing crisis to dominate Spain’s election
data.description: MADRID - After simmering below the surface for years, anger at unaffordable housing in Spain has bubbled over and precipitated a general election that will be dominated by the crisis.

data.title: ‘Sun as black as my lungs’: corruption killing a polluted Albanian city
data.description: ELBASAN, Albania - For several days this summer the Albanian city of Elbasan choked in a dense cloud of stinging smoke coming from the direction of its notorious steelworks.

data.title: US says Fiji-based Chinese official paid bribes for Beijing
data.description: NADI, Fiji - The United States has accused a Fiji-based man working for a Chinese state agency of paying bribes to advance Beijing’s interests in the Pacific nation.

data.title: EU sets sights lower for climate summit
data.description: BRUSSELS - After having its hopes dashed for a more ambitious deal last year in Brazil, the European Union is setting its sights low for next month’s COP31 climate summit in Turkey.
